svg.title: What a workflow of a repository calls
svg.desc: A workflow of the repository, such as issue-assistant.yml, holds what starts it, the most permissions that its jobs get, and one pin, of a release of the issue assistant. It calls the reusable workflow of that release, whose jobs run in the repository, with its events, variables, environment issue-assistant and firewall policy, and each job runs the issue assistant of the same commit. A new release reaches the repository as a pull request of Dependabot or Renovate that moves the pin; install runs again only when a release changes a template.
